name: Maelwing
description: King Baelenys' dragon, ridden since long before his own coronation and as feared throughout the realm as the king himself.

name: Jhagar
description: Bonded to Prince Jacaelon. Jhagar is a genuinely unruly beast, hardly an easy dragon to handle — though he settles somewhat more readily for Jace than for anyone else, the product of hours spent drilling commands into him at the Dragonpit rather than any natural affection.

name: Cloudgazer
description: Princess Saera's dragon, storm-grey and unusually gentle. She retreats to his back whenever the Red Keep grows too loud.

name: Bayle
description: Prince Gaelor's dragon, flown into the Reach during the campaign that ended in the Oldtown Massacre. Bayle has a vicious temper — burning birds, beetles, and anything else that moves before him — yet turns remarkably compliant and well-behaved around his own rider, as though the violence is simply another form of affection.

name: Jadefyre
description: Hatched in Visenor's clutch of three and named by him before his flight from King's Landing. The sole hatchling to survive, Jadefyre was gifted to Maela by royal decree after Visenor's disappearance.

name: Boneskin
traits: Wings Thin Enough to Show the Bone Beneath
Avoided Humans by Choice, Not Fear
Now Ridden — Bareback, No Saddle or Chains
Relocated His Own Egg to a New Nest
description: A wild dragon Visenor found roosting alone in a cave in Dorne's Red Mountains. Small and lean rather than malnourished, Boneskin ate little and shunned human contact out of what maesters believe is a rare, near-human intelligence rather than aggression. After days of patient contact, shared meals, and songs sung in High Valyrian, he accepted Visenor fully — carrying both the prince and his own egg in a night flight to a hidden sea cave along Dorne's coast, safe from men.

name: Boneskin's Egg
traits: Recovered from a Cave in the Red Mountains
Hidden in a Sea Cave in Dorne
description: The dragon egg found alongside Boneskin in his mountain cave. Visenor and Boneskin relocated it together by night flight to a damp, salt-scented sea cave along the Dornish coast — safe from scorpions and, more importantly, from men. Its fate remains unclaimed.

name: Ashfyre
description: One of two hatchlings from Visenor's clutch of three. Named for the small puffs of ash it coughed up whenever it strained to breathe fire, a quirk Visenor found endearing before he understood it as an early sign of the grotesque birth defects that would kill it within days.

name: Palefyre
description: The second of two hatchlings from Visenor's clutch of three. Named for the sickly pallor of its scales, which Visenor took as a harmless trait rather than the first mark of the twisted growth that would claim its life within days, leaving only Jadefyre alive.

name: Unnamed
traits: Complicates the Crown's Pursuit of Vahaemon
description: A dragon reportedly bonded to the exiled Prince Vahaemon during his time in the Free Cities. How or when he acquired it remains unknown to the Crown, but its existence has forced the Small Council to reconsider any direct military action against him, including the proposed campaign toward Tyrosh.
